_about: Every gate number of the strategy pipeline (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-07-strategy-pipeline-design.md; `bp.py pipe`), read by blueprint/pipe_rules.py: need(*keys). Shares and odds are fractions. `card` = what a pipeline card may hold (ways, values a way, indicators, bar sizes, markets, sessions: the evening session is not in this version). `raw` = the raw heat map of stage 1: `strict` is the law's own bar (lines 2.1, 2.2, 2.4), `low` the wider door (a smaller share and half the floor, held to more trades); `floor_part` = the part of line 2.2's cost floor the average trade must reach. `indicator` = stage 3 (`other_markets` = the share of the other markets that must agree). `proof` = stage 4: `reshuffle` is line 2.8's share of the runs; `random_alpha` makes the random bar, 1 - alpha / tries, the law's ladder of line 2.3 carried on past round 5. `box` = the best days taken out at the lock and on the test (lines 3.8, 4.6), and two numbers of the book card: `fast_seconds` (a trade held that long or less is a fast trade: its share of the profit is on the card) and `month_days` (the session days of a month: winning days a month). `prop` = the 30-day prop odds of one strategy on `account`, and `book_accounts`: the rule files of the app's prop simulator whose odds a book card shows; `portfolio` = the bar a portfolio is built to. `test` = stage 6, the read of the unseen days: `one_read_a_slot` false = every pipeline idea gets its own read of the unseen days (the owner, 2026-10-08); true = the toolkit's rule: one read a family, market and session (an idea run by hand through `bp.py test` is always held to that rule; an idea's own read is one read either way). A number the law also carries (raw.strict.share = 2.1, raw.strict.trades = 2.4, proof.reshuffle = 2.8, the random bar = 2.3 to 3 decimals, box.best_days_share = 3.8 and 4.6) must be the same here and in rules.json: pipe_rules.py refuses to load when they differ. A change here is a change of the pipeline's rules: it needs the owner's word. Locked by tests/test_pipe_rules.py. `mode` = "variant" (shipped 2026-10-08, the owner: the map gets a LOOSE check and one box is picked right after it; the hard rules are judged on THAT ONE box) or "map" (the old behaviour: the whole 144-box map is judged by `raw`, `indicator` and `proof`). `variant` = the numbers of variant mode: `map_share` (stage 1: over this share of the boxes must make money), `region_boxes` and `region_trades` (at least this many boxes must be at the floor with at least this many trades; the pick is the middle of them by build net, never the best; the picked box must also have that many trades), `floor_part` (the part of line 2.2's cost floor the picked box's average trade must reach). Locked by tests/test_pipe_rules.py.
